facts.fact_text: The first applicant participated in a demonstration organised by the opposition on 20 October 2012.
The second applicant participated in a demonstration organised by the opposition on 20 October 2012.
Despite the Baku City Executive Authority's refusal to authorise the original location, the organisers decided to hold the demonstration as originally planned.
According to the applicants, the demonstrations were intended to be peaceful and were conducted in a peaceful manner.
The police began to disperse the demonstration of 20 October 2012 as soon as the protesters began to gather.
The police began to disperse the demonstration of 12 January 2013 as soon as the protesters began to gather.
The police began to disperse the demonstration of 26 January 2013 as soon as the protesters began to gather.
The police began to disperse the demonstration of 30 April 2013 as soon as the protesters began to gather.

The circumstances related to the dispersal of the demonstration of 20 October 2012, the first and second applicants' arrests and custody, and subsequent administrative proceedings against them are similar to those in Gafgaz Mammadov v. Azerbaijan (no. 60259/11, judgment of 15 October 2015).

The circumstances related to the dispersal of the demonstrations of 12 January 2013, 26 January 2013, and 30 April 2013, the second and third applicants' arrests and custody, and the subsequent administrative proceedings against them are similar to those in Bayramov v. Azerbaijan ([Committee] nos. 19150/13 and 52022/13, judgment of 6 April 2017).
